_comment: Fix demo for #1616 (wide single-rank formations show a facing whipsaw while pivoting onto a new bearing). Before the fix, this exact scenario made the 30-wide single-rank Cavalry block's facing snap back and forth between near-opposite headings every tick as it approached the map's hill terrain, instead of settling -- PathField._funnel_corner's route_side flipped sign under sub-world-unit position noise. Watch the block pivot smoothly around the hill onto its ordered bearing with no snapping.
caption: #1616: a 30-wide single-rank Cavalry block pivots smoothly around the hill terrain onto its ordered bearing -- no facing whipsaw.
